domain: energy markets / wholesale electricity spot prices
prediction_question: For a New Zealand pricing region (island-level aggregate of published nodal final prices), will the daily mean final wholesale energy price on a trading day about a week ahead exceed a threshold fixed from the training window?
prediction_time: The publication instant of final prices: the Electricity Authority states interim prices 'will be declared to be final prices by 2pm the following business day' (Real-time dispatch and pricing page + Code Part 13); measured on the actual files, Last-Modified minus trade date is p50 1.80 days, max 5.80 days (368 daily files, measured 2026-10-22). Features are final prices for trading dates already published at the instant; the label day is not.
target_definition: Binary: market/island daily mean of DollarsPerMegawattHour over all trading periods of day D+k exceeds a threshold frozen from the training window (candidate fixed thresholds measured at 100/150/200/300 $/MWh; a per-region training-quantile threshold is the alternative). Label source columns: the target day's per-POC prices, excluded from shipped features.

split_strategy: Temporal windows on the 1996-10..2026-10 daily panel, e.g. train 1996-10..2015-12 / eval 2016-01..2020-12 / holdout 2021-01..2026-10; each window contains at least one measured high-price episode (train: 2008-07 measured 9/31 days >$200; eval: 2020-06 measured 5/30 days >$200 with mid-month means to $287; holdout: 2024-08 measured 25/31 days >$200). Positives cluster into multi-day weather/storage episodes, so split capacity is counted per episode-week, not per day; sampled episode weeks measured, exact counts computed at construction over the full files. The 2022-11-01 real-time-pricing regime change (ex-post -> real-time pricing, documented by the publisher) is a structural break: either bound all windows inside one regime or ship a regime indicator; decided and documented at construction.

construction_decisions_2026_10_23.decided_by: advancement session 2026-10-23, before the nz-ea-001 worker launch
construction_decisions_2026_10_23.threshold: NZD 100/MWh fixed (external, frozen from the training-window design). Basis: candidate levels 100/150/200/300 measured on era samples (2020-06: 28/12/5/0 days above each); the Authority's own wholesale review records 2019 average spot $127/MWh and 2020 $105/MWh, so NZD 100 keeps clustered positive target-weeks measurable in every split while staying ~2x the long-run median. Never tuned on a held-out score.
construction_decisions_2026_10_23.splits: anchor-day windows train (first anchor .. 2015-12-31), eval (2016-01-01 .. 2022-10-31), holdout (2022-11-01 .. last anchor). The eval->holdout boundary coincides with the documented 2022-11-01 real-time pricing regime change, so no window straddles the structural break; the holdout is a different market regime by design and per-year reporting is mandatory.
construction_decisions_2026_10_23.grain: one row per (island, anchor trading day D); row_id = {island}-{anchor_date}
construction_decisions_2026_10_23.timing: prediction instant = publication of day D's final prices, conservatively placed at D+6 calendar days: the documented rule is final by 2pm the following business day, and the daily-file channel measured Last-Modified minus trade date = 0-5 calendar days over 365 files (fresh listing 2026-10-23: distribution 1d:249, 2d:52, 3d:52, 4d:9, 5d:5, 0d:1). Features read published prices for trading days <= D only; the target trading day D+7 has not finished trading at the instant, so the label cannot exist there under any publication scheme.
construction_decisions_2026_10_23.event_key: target_week = ISO week of the target day, market-wide (both islands share a week). Weeks within one long storage crisis are not fully independent; the count is a capacity floor per the gate's rule, not an independence proof.
construction_decisions_2026_10_23.channel_ownership: monthly ByMonth files own trading dates <= 2025-10-31; daily files own dates > 2025-10-31 (interim _I and _incomplete variants excluded and counted); the 10 overlap days 2025-10-22..31 are cross-checked between channels (max |diff| asserted <= 0.01).
construction_decisions_2026_10_23.mapping: POC -> island from the current-vintage NetworkSupplyPointsTable (894 POCs, 0 island conflicts measured); POCs absent from it are excluded and counted per year (199610 first-day sample: 213/225 mapped, 12 retired POCs unmapped).
construction_decisions_2026_10_23.known_events: Aug 2024 dry-year episode (EA Review of winter 2024: 'in early August the average daily price reached $820/MWh') must exceed; 2008-07-01 (record-measured market mean 306) must exceed; Jan 1997 quiet-era control (record-measured monthly max 50) must not. Asserted by the build from the constructed panel.
